input.quote: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
input.rationale: Section 20(d) imposes an absolute consent requirement on both parties with no reasonableness standard and no carve-out permitting Sparkling to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; Section 3(c) reinforces this by prohibiting Sparkling from assigning except as authorized by Garman in writing. That is a blanket prohibition on customer assignment with no M&A carve-out, which is walk-away territory and falls short of the fallback (mutual right to assign to successors on written notice, consent otherwise not unreasonably withheld). The document contains no change-of-control provision, so no Vendor exit or re-pricing right arises today; we added confirming language that our change of control is not an assignment. Redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out, a reasonableness standard on consent, and a bar on Garman assigning to our competitors, with a conforming cross-reference in Section 3(c).

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Sparkling, a reasonableness standard on consent, and a bar on Garman assigning to our competitors.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added the customary carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and made consent subject to a reasonableness standard, with Garman barred from assigning to our competitors. Our playbook does not accept a blanket bar on customer assignment with no M&A carve-out; a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice is our fallback.

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed; provided that (i) Sparkling may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or business, upon written notice to Garman, and (ii) Garman shall not assign this Agreement to any competitor of Sparkling. No change of control of Sparkling shall constitute an assignment or give Garman any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
